validator_nature.what_they_are: verify_freeze.py and verify_freeze.mjs are DIVERSE STRUCTURAL VALIDATORS: two separately-authored programs that check the structural well-formedness and internal consistency of this frozen reviewer package and print FREEZE_STRUCTURE_VALID.
validator_nature.what_they_are_not: They are NOT independent final-proof verifiers and NOT an optimality proof. They cannot establish U_T closure, greatest-element, uniqueness, refinement, or any theorem. A re-hashed semantic mutation of the contract (e.g. a winner-only U_T with a regenerated seal) is out of reach of a structural validator by construction; detecting it is a later proof obligation (FOC-04, T2), not a gate check. Both were authored in one session and are diverse, not cryptographically independent.
validator_nature.agreement_rule: Both must agree; disagreement is BLOCKED.

transport_note: A ZIP or other archive is a NEUTRAL TRANSPORT CONTAINER. It binds bytes but does not itself prove architecture quality or mathematical optimality. Creator approval is a separate hash-bound receipt and does not alter frozen bytes.

typed_definitions.A_BIND: the exact closed binding architecture-and-mechanism axis registry AX-01..AX-22 in ALL-AXIS-DOMINANCE-SPEC.json.
typed_definitions.U_T: every executable implementation constructible at cutoff from independently-inventoried present-day technology, inside a frozen resource/toolchain/legal envelope. U_T is a plural universal set and is NOT the winner or any single-candidate set.
typed_definitions.A_T: typed architecture specifications of the frozen grammar.
typed_definitions.D_T: normalized executable equivalence-class representatives; D_T = U_T / approx_T.
typed_definitions.F_T: executables of D_T passing all hard invariants, universal B0 refinement, FOC-18 commercial eligibility, and total conformance to their Spec(e).

domain_closure.non_vacuity_obligation: B0 in U_T AND E_star in U_T AND D_T = U_T/approx_T (each u maps to exactly one class d; each d has a real u).
domain_closure.independence_rule: U_T is defined and sealed independently of D_T and BEFORE any winner; not defined post hoc from examined candidates; D_T is not a chosen subset of the quotient image.
closure_admissible_only_by: exhaustive symbolic class partition with a mechanically proved per-class upper bound
not_closure: K rounds with no new find

objective_order.bins: each objective pre-committed, with a conservative uncertainty rule, to a typed integer/rational bin.
objective_order.ge_T: top tier where vectors differ: e >=_T x iff componentwise no-worse; mixed => INCOMPARABLE. Equal vectors: e >=_T x iff e universally trace-refines x.
objective_order.strict_and_equiv: e >_T x iff e>=_T x and not x>=_T e; e approx_T x iff both.
required_lemmas: approx_T is an equivalence and a congruence
UNKNOWN never becomes equality or dominance
objective_order.commercial_strict_rule: For every b in B_COMM and every a in A_BIND, StrictBetter_a(E_star,b). Strictness is componentwise and non-compensatory. Equality, interval overlap, incomparability or UNKNOWN fails that cell and T6.
forbidden_substitutes: better on one or some axes

theorems.statement: Dom(B0) subset Dom(E_star) AND universal trace/capability/liveness refinement of B0 by E_star; candidate-defined admission does not shrink the domain.
E_star is the greatest element of F_T, via independent U_T, surjective closure, and a dominance proof for every executable class.
Uniqueness up to material equivalence approx_T; an incomparable maximum makes T3 FAIL; disclosure is not proof.
Total architecture->source->executable refinement and property transport.
Non-vacuous conditional ceiling: hashed jointly-satisfiable TCB, actual-build instantiation, T1..T4 plus T6 and T7, independent replay.

For every b in B_COMM and every a in A_BIND, E_star is STRICTLY_BETTER on a; E_star universally refines and materially improves every reachable baseline capability/trace; Capabilities(b) is a proper subset of Capabilities(E_star).

There exists a finite approved exact repository change sequence Delta_B0 with Apply(B0,Delta_B0)=E_star; each verified increment preserves all still-binding B0 capabilities/invariants; the final Andrianna source/build/executable instantiate A_star/E_star; and the repository crosswalk/manifest is total and contains no parallel authority.

final_theorem.greatest_element: E_star in F_T AND B0 refines-into E_star AND for all x in F_T: E_star >=_T x.
final_theorem.uniqueness: for all x in F_T: (x >=_T E_star) => (x approx_T E_star).
final_theorem.strict_commercial_superiority: for all b in B_COMM and for all a in A_BIND: StrictBetter_a(E_star,b), and Capabilities(b) is a proper subset of Capabilities(E_star).
final_theorem.andrianna_transformational_realization: there exists a finite approved Delta_B0 such that Apply(B0,Delta_B0)=E_star, every approved increment preserves all still-binding B0 capabilities/invariants, and the final Andrianna repository build is the exact proved E_star rather than a disconnected system.
final_theorem.weaker_pareto_note: 'for all x in F_T: not (x >_T E_star)' proves only Pareto non-dominance, NOT the ceiling. 'No worse on all and better on one' is also insufficient for the creator's commercial-superiority claim.

fail_closed.number_word_count_discipline: A governed count named in prose must be mechanically derivable and agree, in digits OR spelled out (thirty-eight, eight, nine, two, three, four). [R5 B1/B2/B6]
fail_closed.cross_document_count_agreement: Same governed quantity in two documents must be identical; disagreement is BLOCKED. [R5 B3]
fail_closed.seal_prose_vs_counts_agreement: A seal's prose must not state a governed count that disagrees with its own machine-read counts. [R5 B6]
fail_closed.no_null_validation: Every validation field must be a concrete value; a null validation is BLOCKED. [R5 B4]
fail_closed.exit_code_completeness: Every exit code a checker can emit must be declared; an undeclared exit code is treated as BLOCKED. [R5 B5]

Commercial strictness is componentwise: equality, average, weighted/composite scoring, compensation, trade-off and better-on-one-axis are forbidden.
Every commercial UNKNOWN, unavailable result, unmapped capability or content-confounded comparison blocks.
Capability surfaces must be proper subsets under universal trace/capability refinement; feature counts cannot substitute.
FOC-19/T7 require E_star to be the exact implemented successor of Andrianna B0 with a total repository census, bidirectional crosswalk and approved file/package/symbol-level change plan.
A disconnected greenfield result, wrapper-only substitute, parallel authority, capability regression, unexplained B0 surface or unproved removal/migration blocks.
The blind producer capsule and hidden reviewer capsule are cryptographically separated and the producer sees only the reviewer-capsule commitment.

architecture_neutral.subset_rule: A proof of a subset is a proof of the subset only.

strict_all_axis_commercial_dominance.absolute_ceiling_rule: If any commercial baseline already occupies a proved absolute ceiling on a binding axis, strict improvement is impossible and the commercial-superiority claim remains BLOCKED; equality is not renamed superiority.
strict_all_axis_commercial_dominance.axis_closure_rule: Every material observable commercial mechanism property maps to exactly one binding axis or receives a mechanically checked irrelevance proof. An unmapped property opens a new axis epoch and forces replay.
strict_all_axis_commercial_dominance.product_update_rule: Any validated update to a mandatory product moves the live status to CEILING_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED and reopens FOC-18/T6.

andrianna_b0_transformation.target: The final E_star is the verified evolutionary successor implemented in the Andrianna B0 repository, not a disconnected design or adjacent system.
andrianna_b0_transformation.post_reveal_requirements: Exhaustive semantic repository census; total architecture-to-path/package/symbol/store/gate crosswalk; exact ADD/MODIFY/REFACTOR/MOVE/REPLACE/REMOVE plan; capability preservation matrix; migration DAG; verification matrix; removal proofs; final implementation manifest.

universal_escalation.success_requires: Domain closure, complete canonical-class coverage or symbolic upper bounds, greatest element, uniqueness, executable refinement, FOC-18/T6 strict all-axis commercial superiority, zero live material defeaters and independent replay.

continual_evolution.epoch_theorem: At every certified epoch t: for all x in F_t, Omega_t >=_t x.
continual_evolution.monotonic_ratchet: Omega_(t+1) preserves all still-binding invariants and reachable capabilities of Omega_t and is no worse on every binding objective before it may replace Omega_t.
continual_evolution.reopen_rule: Any validated new constructible class, challenger, frontier fact, workload, objective, invariant, equivalence rule, evaluator input, TCB change, proof counterexample or update to CoCounsel Legal, Lexis+ with Protégé or Harvey moves status to CEILING_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED and reopens affected obligations including FOC-18/T6.
continual_evolution.restoration_rule: Current-ceiling status returns only after full affected-proof replay and independent reproduction.
